prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Sunken Kirk: a half-drowned stone kirk and churchyard among cold marsh pools and wandering wisps. A hushed, mournful theme that slowly finds light in flute and harp. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 2 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
